title: the proof of the pipeline measures every step of the chain and every diagram
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D0): the pipeline of the diagrams works, but the check of wave 81 promised more than it proved, and the discriminator of wave 81 named eight gaps (F1–F8).  The code of the pipeline is honest; the proof is not.  The wave does not touch the pipeline, the skins or the site: it makes the check such, what the promise was.  (1) **Every step of the chain of the search is measured** (F1): the fixture carries four runs, one for each step -- the variable of the environment, the command on PATH, the binary of `~/.nix-profile/bin`, the glob of the store of nix -- and in each run exactly one step is available, and the run must end with the code 0 and two pictures.  The chain is also measured as a text: `find_tool` is defined in exactly one file of `scripts/`, and `scripts/dev` reads it.  (2) **Not one diagram but several** (F2): the fixture carries two diagrams with different names, the list of the expected pictures is derived from the tree, and a picture must carry the label of its own source and not the label of another one -- a pipeline that overwrites a source with a fixed diagram breaks the check.  (3) **The code 1 is measured** (F3): a broken diagram, a PlantUML that writes no picture, and a PlantUML that writes a picture with `Syntax Error` are three different failures, and each of them must answer with the code 1.  (4) **The expected colours come from the tokens** (F4): the check reads the values of the tokens out of `site/styles.css` and no hex-literal of an expected colour is left in it; the skin of the fixture carries a marker of its own, so a pipeline that bakes the skin into the code is caught.  (5) **The words of the report are not measured** (F5): the number of the pictures and of the diagrams is read from the tree, and a wording is not a promise.  (6) **The small things** (F6–F8): the number of the checks of the method is 105 (99 `.el` and 6 `.sh`), the copy of the search that `mathc` carries is named, and `site/assets/diagrams/.gitkeep` is listed in the `touches` of wave 81.  The claim `the-diagram-pipeline-renders-both-themes` keeps its id and is amended, not rewritten (the precedent is §16.28): the promise becomes exactly what the check proves.
objection: The claim is about a pipeline and not about a picture: the wave draws no diagram of the site, and the check draws its probe diagrams in temporary trees, so the tree of the repository is never written.  The check measures the chain of the search with four hermetic runs, and each of them is a run of the real pipeline in a tree where exactly one step of the chain can answer -- the price is that the check is slower than the wave 81 one was (12 seconds against 2.6), and the price is paid for measurability and not for the sake of it.  The chain of the search of the check is a chain of its own: the check must not lean on the code that it checks.  The step in the store of nix is host-specific, and the first match of the shell is taken, so the choice is the same on every run of the machine.  The colours of the palettes are bound to the tokens of `site/styles.css` by name, so a rename of a token in the CSS breaks the check: that is the price of the binding and the point of it -- a palette that drifts from the site is a picture of another site.  The marker of the skin of the fixture proves that the picture is drawn with the skin of the file, and the marker lives in the copy of the skin inside the fixture and in nowhere else: the palettes of the repository carry no marker, and a palette with a marker of its own would be a palette with a colour the site does not know.  The pipeline is the instrument of the author and not a build step of the site: the published site carries the ready SVG, and a site that has no PlantUML is not broken -- it is a site whose pictures were drawn earlier.  The code 3 of the missing instrument is the code of 'unknown', and it is the same code the checks of the method use for a machine that cannot answer.
refuted_by: a step of the chain of the search does not work alone, or the pipeline renders one theme only, or a diagram of the tree is not drawn, or a picture is not drawn from its own source, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the tool is not there, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when PlantUML fails or writes no picture, or the skins of the themes do not carry the colours of the site, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `the-diagram-pipeline-renders-both-themes' is the same, the text says that every step of the chain works alone and that the pipeline answers with the code 1 when PlantUML fails, the `falsifier' names the new refusals, and the `control' is the same as it was: the loop of the themes loses the dark one.  Fifteen controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-20 -- seven by the writer of the wave and eight more by the parent, and the parent's eight were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, in 12 seconds.  (2) The words of the report are changed in any way -- the code 0: a check that leans on a wording is a check that fails on a spelling.  (3) The token of the site changes and the skin follows it -- the code 0: the binding is by the name of the token, and a change of the value of a token is not a defect.  (4) The skin drifts from the token (`StateBorderColor #123456') -- «the StateBorderColor of the palette of the light theme is #123456 and the token --face-divider of the site is #999999»; code 1.  (5) The skin of the dark theme is gone -- the code 1 and not 2: a broken promise is not a machine that cannot answer.  (6) The loop of the themes loses the dark one (the control of the claim) -- «the step of the environment of the chain of the search drew [probe-light.svg ] and not the two pictures of the probe»; code 1.  (7) PlantUML fails on a broken diagram and the pipeline answers 0 -- «the pipeline answered 0 where PlantUML cannot read the diagram and the answer must be 1»; code 1.  (8) The pipeline draws only the first diagram -- «the pipeline drew [alpha-dark.svg alpha-light.svg ] and not two pictures for every diagram» and «the picture of beta (light) is missing or empty»; code 1.  (9) The step of the PATH of the chain of the search is removed -- «the step of the PATH of the chain of the search answered 3 and not 0»; code 1.  (10) The step of the environment is removed -- the same shape; code 1.  (11) The skin is baked into the code instead of being read from the file -- «the picture of alpha (light) does not carry the marker YeahWave83MarkerFont of the skin of the fixture: the picture was not drawn with the skin of the file»; code 1.  (12) The chain of the search is copied into a second file -- «the chain of the search is defined in [scripts/lib/tools-copy.sh scripts/lib/tools.sh] and not in one place»; code 1.  (13) `scripts/dev` does not read `scripts/lib/tools.sh` -- «the pipeline does not use the chain of the search»; code 1.  (14) No temporary tree is left behind -- the count is zero.  The measurement of the wave: the check is 736 lines and 27.5 kB (the wave 81 one was 410 lines and 13.6 kB), and it goes in 12 seconds (2.6 before); the fixture carries two diagrams of the tree and four runs of the chain; the check of the method has 105 files -- 99 `.el` and 6 `.sh`.  The small things of the discriminator are closed here: the number of the checks is 105 in `docs/PLAN.md` (§16.72 and §16.73), the copy of the search that `mathc` carries (`find_mathc` in `scripts/lib/method.sh` -- it searches for the binary of the method and takes no step in the store) is named in the documents, and `site/assets/diagrams/.gitkeep` is listed in the `touches` of wave 81.
